[[Sea Mauville]] }} '''Diancie Shines''' (Japanese: '''ディアンシー、輝く''' ''Diancie, Shine'') is the 606th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 11th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Ruby}}, {{adv|Emerald}}, and [[Ultima]] {{m|Fly|fly}} on the backs of their Pokémon as they follow [[Drake]] and the [[S.S. Tidal]] to [[Meteor Falls]]. {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias}} notes that the glittering Pokémon on {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}}'s back is called {{p|Diancie}}, while the mysterious Pokémon that is following Emerald is called {{p|Hoopa}}. When Ruby is about to explain to Emerald what he has been up to the last few days, Emerald reveals that Latias has already used her powers to show him. Ruby wonders aloud if Meteor Falls is where the village of the [[Draconid people]] is located, and Drake tells him that it is common for {{type|Dragon}} [[Type expert|specialists]] to gather there. The group heads inside to eat dinner with [[Mr. Briney]]. Ruby asks Ultima why she wanted to tag along, and she reveals that it was because she is interested in the scroll that Ruby stole from Zinnia. She reveals that the scroll is like an ancient [[TM]], capable of teaching {{m|Dragon Ascent}} to a special Pokémon who is referred to as the "{{p|Rayquaza|Dragon Lord}}." Ruby deduces that Dragon Ascent must be the key to stopping the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]] from destroying the world, which is why Zinnia had taken it in the first place. At [[Sea Mauville]], [[Mr. Stone]] stares sadly at the [[Ultimate weapon|Absorber]] as he accepts that the world will come to an end without the dimensional shifter. An idea suddenly comes to {{Steven}}, and he announces that it is still possible to save the world, since Hoopa has simply transported the device to another location. Steven realizes that they can use their technology to detect the dimensional shifter, and Mr. Stone commends him for his determination. Steven takes a call from [[Professor Cozmo]], and is shocked to learn that he has the dimensional shifter in his possession. Professor Cozmo reveals that Sapphire is staying with him to protect the rocket, and also that {{tc|Interviewers|journalists}} are swarming the [[Mossdeep Space Center]] after a news story aired about the meteor. Steven and his father head for [[Mossdeep City]], departing on {{TP|Steven|Metagross}}. On the S.S. Tidal, Emerald is awakened by Ruby, who is filming Diancie and Hoopa as they play together. When Diancie creates a jewel for Hoopa, Hoopa shows off by using its rings to summon even more jewels. Emerald is surprised to learn that the rings can both absorb objects, and have them taken out of them. {{adv|Amber}} and [[Blaise]] continue to spy on Hoopa on the shore of a small island. Amber has his {{p|Gorebyss}} send out one droplet into the water. The single droplet charges up into a powerful attack, blasting water at Hoopa. Blaise orders his {{p|Slugma}} to signal their location, causing Hoopa to use its rings to transport itself there. Gorebyss then attacks it with another blast of water, and Blaise has Slugma create an illusion of a strong Pokémon through the ring. Determined not to lose to the illusory Pokémon, Hoopa summons both a {{p|Groudon}} and a {{p|Kyogre}}. Inside the ship, Mr. Briney sleeps through a radio report about a [[Red Orb]] and a [[Blue Orb]] being stolen from a [[Sea Cottage|laboratory]] in [[Kanto]]. Riding on a speedboat, the orbs are seen to be held by [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] as they their way to [[Hoenn]]. ==Major events== * [[Ultima]] looks at the scroll {{adv|Ruby}} took from [[Zinnia]] and discovers it will teach the move {{m|Dragon Ascent}}. * {{Steven}} contacts [[Professor Cozmo]] and learns {{adv|Sapphire}} is in [[Mossdeep City]], but isn't able to speak. * Steven and [[Mr. Stone]] head to the [[Mossdeep Space Center]]. * {{adv|Amber}} and [[Blaise]] attack {{p|Hoopa}}. * [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]] steal the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s and return to [[Hoenn]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * [[Drake]] * [[Steven Stone]] * [[Archie]] * [[Maxie]] * {{adv|Amber}} * [[Ultima]]/{{tt|Kimberly|Chuang Yi}} * [[Zinnia]] (flashback) * [[Mr. Briney]] * [[Mr. Stone]] * [[Professor Cozmo]] * [[Blaise]]/{{tt|Mack|Chuang Yi}} * [[Renza]] (flashback) * [[Jinga]] (flashback) * [[Tomatoma]] (flashback) * {{tc|Swimmer}} Jack * {{tc|Sailor}} * {{tc|Cameraman}} * Professor Cozmo's assistants ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Metagross}} ({{OP|Steven|Metagross}}) * {{p|Dragonite}} ([[Ultima]]'s) * {{p|Gorebyss}} ({{adv|Amber}}'s) * {{p|Slugma}} ([[Blaise]]'s) * {{p|Flygon}} (×3; [[Draconid people|Draconid]]s'; flashback) * {{p|Latias}} ({{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias|Adventures}}) * {{p|Latios}} ({{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios|Adventures}}) * {{P|Kyogre}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre|Adventures}}) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}) * {{p|Diancie}} * {{p|Hoopa}} (Confined) {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS605 |prevtitle=Swampert Smashes |nextcode=PS607 |nexttitle=Blastoise Transforms |series=Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire |colorscheme=ORAS}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[de:Episode 10]] [[es:PMS606]] [[fr:Chapitre 606 (Pocket Monsters Special)]] [[it:PS606]] [[zh:宝可梦特别篇 第606话]]
